newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs focus glued on Bund, German CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs focus glued on Bund, German CPI data.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds (OLOs) set out flat-to-higher on Thursday with dealers saying the market, in the absence of U.S. data, was looking for Germany to provide direction.

"Everybody is looking to the Bund for the moment. If the level of 100.88/96 holds then we could pull back to 100.60. If 100.96 or the figure (101) is broken we can move higher again," a trader at a domestic primary dealer said.
The German market started lower on Thursday, in line with a weak overnight performance from U.S. Treasuries, but moved up again on the back of early inflation data from German states.
